title: Two-star general furious at doctor's alien bodies question
summary: John Blitch tells of Two-star general furious at doctor's alien bodies question, about about six months before Blitch's visit at near Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: goes well there was this a two star general that came in here uh about six months ago and I did that same thing and he got furious with me

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, and who says he was taken by an alien, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast about a visit to a doctor near Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, a base long rumoured to hold alien bodies. According to Blitch, the doctor said he had asked the same question about alien bodies to a two-star general about six months earlier, and the general got furious with him. He tells it to suggest that the question struck a nerve with senior military people.
